mentions.name: Sept Marriane
mentions.description: An all-in-one operations workspace built around a form and workflow engine with a backoffice layer on top of submissions. Core features include tasks, assignments, reminders, budgets, client/contact directories, inventories, meetings, and an internal knowledge base. Operational add-ons cover quizzes & assessments, certificate generation, invoicing, a document repository, reusable email templates, and an anomalies module. Positioned as "what happens after the form" — one calm, predictable system instead of a stack of tools.
mentions.problem: Teams (especially HR and ops in small/medium companies) need to launch and operate fast, but once data comes in, everything falls apart into spreadsheets, emails, and half-used tools — the real work starts after collecting data.
mentions.audience: HR teams, marketing teams, and SMEs (small/medium companies), Morocco/EU-oriented
mentions.source_excerpt: An all-in-one operations workspace that starts with forms but doesn’t stop there.
